insights.title: Forecast ↓ — Expect App Total Revenue to soften next period — App Total New Subs -23.2%, led by YCP.
insights.body: App Total New Subs -23.2% runs well below its upstream (App Total New User -8.9%, App Total Install +1.1%; Δ -19.3pp). With the 7-day trial lag, expect App Total Revenue to soften next period. The drag is concentrated in YCP (-27.3%); YCV is -9.2%.

insights.title: Lead–lag check — App Total Revenue is tracking its subs signal as expected.
insights.body: App Total Revenue 07-26 vs 07-19 = -0.4% tracks its 7-day driver App Total New Subs 07-19 vs 07-12 = -4.1% — revenue is following the subs signal as expected.

insights.title: Funnel conversion — Conversion to New Subs splits by app — YCV softening (-9.2% vs upstream +4.7%).
insights.body: Upstream→New Subs conversion splits by app: YCV -9.2% vs upstream +4.7% (conversion softening); YCP -27.3% vs upstream -6.3% (conversion softening). (Revenue is downstream and lags ~7d — see the lead–lag check.)

insights.title: App split — App Total New User -8.9% concentrated in YCP — not platform-wide.
insights.body: App Total New User -8.9% is uneven by app (All App -8.9%, YMK -9.0%, YCP -9.7%, YCV +1.4%) — driven mainly by YCP, not a platform-wide shift.

insights.title: Country outlier — US is the outlier on App Total Install (-4.5% vs +1.1%).
insights.body: App Total Install · All App: US -4.5% vs all-country +1.1% (Δ -5.6pp; ≈37% of revenue).
